title: Integrate Claude Desktop with Claude Code
body:
I'd like to propose integrating Claude Desktop as an official GUI frontend for Claude Code to enhance developer UX and accessibility. 

While Claude Code's terminal interface is powerful and composable, a desktop GUI integration would solve several pain points: 
     
Chat history management - long coding sessions often hit conversation limits, and while Claude Code has resume functionality, a GUI would make browsing and searching conversation history much more intuitive; 

Visual workflow enhancement - developers could benefit from a side-by-side view showing code changes, file trees, and conversation context simultaneously; 

Accessibility - a GUI option would make Claude Code more approachable for developers who prefer visual interfaces while preserving all terminal functionality for power users. 

This wouldn't replace the terminal experience but rather offer a complementary interface that leverages Claude Code's existing conversation storage, codebase awareness, and SDK capabilities through a more visual, persistent environment. The integration could maintain full compatibility with existing workflows while providing enhanced context management for complex, multi-session development tasks. 

Additionally, extending Claude Desktop to Linux/Ubuntu would provide platform parity with Claude Code's existing cross-platform support.
author: kerim-ca
